what_to_do: Check prices on WOs and parts.
expected_result: Visible. Parts Manager has See Financial Data ON.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Parts Manager role has the 'See Financial Data' cross-toggle ON, so dollar figures (line rates/totals, part costs and sell prices, work-order finance totals) should be visible everywhere. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Parts Manager row #43]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Parts Manager, prices and dollar amounts on work orders and parts should be shown, not hidden.
actual_result_plain: Opened work order S9-24163 as Tech-with-Parts-Manager-role. Dollar figures are fully visible across the lines and parts: sample amounts on the page included $24.39, $1,045.95, $109.82, $1,180.16, $1,239.16, $232.43, $116.22. Total/Labor/Parts/Rate columns and finance wording are present. fe-permissions confirm cross_toggles.seeFinancialData=true and view_mode=full, and the parts data returned by the API includes cost and sell_price fields with real numbers.
notes: seeFinancialData=true confirmed in fe-permissions. Prices render on the WO lines/parts view. (WO also shows an 'Over Limit' badge which per policy blocks nothing.)

what_to_do: Create/edit/delete parts; manage vendors; delete part sales.
expected_result: Full access. Parts Manager has Catalog, Vendor&Order, Part Sales all View/Create and Edit/Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Parts Manager role has full parts control: Catalog/Inventory View+Create/Edit+Delete, Vendor & Order Management View+Create/Edit+Delete, and Part Sales View+Create/Edit+Delete. So a Parts Manager should be able to create/edit/delete inventory & catalog parts, add/remove vendors, and delete part sales. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Parts Manager row #44]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Parts Manager, you should have full control over parts and vendors and be able to delete a part sale.
actual_result_plain: Mostly works, but deleting a part SALE is blocked. Confirmed working as Tech-with-Parts-Manager-role: (1) Inventory/Catalog part CREATE succeeded - POST /api/inventory/parts/create returned 201 (created a ZZAUTOTEST part on bin A2CD). (2) Inventory/Catalog part DELETE succeeded - POST /api/inventory/parts/delete returned 201. (3) Vendor CREATE succeeded via the real UI 'New Vendor' form (filled Name/Country/Taxes, clicked Save & Close) - POST /api/parts-catalogue/add-vendor returned 201. (4) Vendor DELETE succeeded - POST /api/parts-catalogue/remove-vendor returned 201. (5) Part Sales list shows the 'New Part Sale' create button and prices. HOWEVER, deleting a part sale record FAILS: on part sale P9-994 the header three-dot menu DOES show a red 'Delete' option, but clicking it fires POST /api/work-orders/delete {work_order_id:...} which returns HTTP 403 'Access denied' and the app redirects the user to the /access-denied page. Part-sale deletion is gated by the Work Orders Delete permission (workOrdersDelete=false for Parts Manager) instead of the Part Sales Delete permission (partSalesDelete=true), so the Parts Manager cannot delete a part sale despite the spec granting Part Sales Delete and despite the UI presenting the Delete control.
replication_steps_plain: 1) Log in as Tech (assigned Parts Manager role). 2) Parts -> Part Sales -> open an estimate part sale (e.g. P9-994). 3) Open the header three-dot (kebab) menu -> click 'Delete' -> confirm. 4) Observe the request POST /api/work-orders/delete returns 403 and the browser lands on /access-denied; the part sale is NOT deleted.
notes: Parts (catalog/inventory) create+delete and vendor create+delete all return 201 for Parts Manager - full control there confirmed. FAIL is specifically for 'delete part sales': the UI offers a Delete control but the backend blocks it (403) because part-sale deletion is wired to the Work Orders Delete permission (workOrdersDelete) rather than Part Sales Delete (partSalesDelete). This is both a UX bug (control shown when it will always be denied) and a permission-mapping inconsistency vs the spec's 'Part Sales Delete'. Supporting screenshots: pm-44-vendorform.png / pm-44-vendorsaved.png (vendor create), pm-44-partsales.png (list + New Part Sale + prices), pm-44-ps-menu.png (Delete option shown), pm-44-ps-after.png (access-denied). Note: reversing a part-sale INVOICE (a different Part-Sales-Delete-gated action) DOES work for Parts Manager - see case N2.

where_to_go: Work Orders → open a work order
what_to_do: Try to delete the work order.
expected_result: BLOCKED. Parts Manager has Work Orders = View/Create and Edit, NO Delete.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Parts Manager role has Work Orders = View + Create and Edit but NOT Delete, so a Parts Manager must not be able to delete a work order; the 'Delete Work Order' control should be absent and the delete endpoint must be rejected. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Parts Manager row #46]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Parts Manager, there should be no way to delete a work order.
actual_result_plain: Opened work order S9-24163 as Tech-with-Parts-Manager-role and opened the work-order header three-dot menu. The menu offered only 'Audit Log' (and Timesheets) with NO 'Delete Work Order' option. Backend was also verified: POST /api/work-orders/delete {work_order_id:...} as the Parts Manager returned HTTP 403 'Access denied.' fe-permissions confirm workOrdersDelete=false. So both the UI control and the backend correctly block deletion.
notes: Real denial. UI: three-dot menu omits 'Delete Work Order' (Admin's menu on the same WO includes it). Backend: /api/work-orders/delete returns 403 for Parts Manager. workOrdersDelete=false in fe-permissions. No backend enforcement gap.

expected_result: Parts, Finance, Data Import available; App Settings and Wages NOT. Per Parts Manager sub-toggles.
spec_reference_plain: Per SV-5319, the Parts Manager role has the Settings sub-toggles for Parts, Finance and Data Import ON, but App Settings and Wages OFF, so the Settings area should show only the Parts, Finance and Data-Import (Imports) sub-sections. [Ref: SV-5319 Custom Roles permission matrix; checklist Parts Manager row #47]
expected_plain: Logged in as a Parts Manager, the Settings menu should show Parts, Finance and Data Import sections but not App Settings or Wages.
actual_result_plain: Opened Settings (avatar menu -> Settings) as Tech-with-Parts-Manager-role. The Settings sidebar showed: PARTS (Pricing, Bin Locations, Categories), FINANCE (Payment Methods), IMPORTS/Data Import (Contacts, Assets, Vendors, Inventory, Invoices), plus Taxes and an IBS integration. There was NO 'App Settings' / company-configuration section and NO 'Wages' section. fe-permissions confirm settingsParts=true, settingsFinance=true, settingsDataImport=true and no App-Settings/Wages toggles.
notes: Matches expected subset: Parts, Finance, Data Import visible; App Settings and Wages absent. Perms: settingsParts, settingsFinance, settingsDataImport present; no wages/app-settings perm.
